info.title: Namify MetaSearch API
info.description:
MetaSearch returns a ranked set of available domains for a search term — the exact match, available alternatives, and optional AI-generated suggestions — each with live pricing.

All requests require a bearer token issued for your partner account. Results (TLDs and pricing) are scoped to your account's configured catalogue.

**Base URL:** `https://metasearch.namify.host`

get.description: MetaSearch takes a search term and returns a ranked set of domains — the exact match, plus available alternatives (when `autosuggest` is on) and AI-suggested brandable names (when `aisuggest` is on) — each with live pricing. The response leads with a featured result (`type: "hero"`), then the results list, then any AI-suggested names.

parameters.name: search_term
parameters.description: The name to search — either a bare label (`coffee`) or a full domain including a TLD (`coffee.com`). Include a TLD to search that exact domain; the matching row is returned flagged `is_searched_exact: true`. Maximum 63 characters.

parameters.name: autosuggest
parameters.description: When `true`, MetaSearch automatically suggests additional available names — close variations coined around your `search_term` — and folds them into the results list alongside the exact match. Defaults to `false`.

parameters.name: aisuggest
parameters.description: When `true`, MetaSearch appends a block of AI-suggested names — brandable, model-coined alternatives to your `search_term`, each returned with `type: "ai_suggestion"`. Independent of `autosuggest`; defaults to `false`.

200.description: Ranked search results with live availability and pricing.

400.description: `search_term` is missing, empty, or longer than 63 characters.

401.description: API key is missing or invalid.

503.description: The domain availability service is temporarily unavailable.

bearerAuth.description: Your partner API key. Include it in the Authorization header as `Bearer <token>`. Unauthenticated requests return 401 Unauthorized.

results.description: The full result set, in render order: the `hero` first (when present), then the results list, then any AI-suggested names. Never paginated.

results_hidden.description: Results-list items beyond the first 10 (use to drive a "show more" affordance).

message.description: Present only when there are no results (e.g. "No results for this name").

domain_name.description: The full domain name (SLD + TLD), e.g. `coffee.com`.

sld.description: The second-level domain — the name portion, left of the dot (e.g. `coffee` in `coffee.com`).

tld.description: The top-level domain — the extension, without the leading dot (e.g. `com`).

available.description: Whether the domain is available to register through your partner account. Taken names can still appear (e.g. the searched exact) with `available: false` and `pricing: null`.

type.description: What kind of result this is. `hero` — the featured pick MetaSearch leads with; `result` — a standard results-list entry (an exact match, or an automatically suggested name when `autosuggest` is on); `ai_suggestion` — an AI-suggested, model-coined name (returned when `aisuggest` is on).

is_searched_exact.description: `true` only for the row matching the exact domain in the `search_term` (when a TLD was included, e.g. `coffee.com`) — use it to highlight "the domain you searched," whether available or taken. `false` on every other row.

pricing.description: Pricing for the domain, from your account's catalogue. `null` when the domain is unavailable.

register.description: First-year registration price. `0` means the first year is free — see `is_free_first_year`.

renew.description: Standard annual renewal price, charged from the second year onward.

period.description: Billing period the amounts apply to (always "year").

is_free_first_year.description: `true` when the first year is free (`register` is `0`); the customer pays `renew` from year two.

summary.description: A ready-to-display price string you can render as-is (e.g. "1st Year Free, then $9.99/yr" or "$12.99/yr").

typed_tld.description: The TLD parsed from the `search_term` when a full domain was searched (e.g. `com` for `coffee.com`), otherwise `null`.

autosuggest.description: The resolved value of the `autosuggest` flag for this request.

aisuggest.description: The resolved value of the `aisuggest` flag for this request.

error.example: search_term is required and must not be empty after sanitisation
